title: Verify indicator-type mapping through DHIS2 global metadata settings
problem: Issue #1255 requests remapping indicator types when source and target DHIS2 instances use different definitions. The pinned global-mapping model list omits this type; end-to-end behavior is not yet reproduced.
humanitarian_relevance: MetaData Sync is explicitly recommended in WHO malaria repository guidance. Reliable mapping could reduce integration work, but contribution-specific time savings and deployment are unverified.

evidence.claim: Issue #1255 attributes an indicator-type mapping gap to CHAI/UiO work and says it remained unbuilt in July 2026. No Humanifest acceptance is present.

At the pinned development revision, InstanceMappingPage global.models lists seven model classes and no indicator-type model. This is a static source observation, not a runtime reproduction or proof of every mapping path.

Seven isolated checks run the unchanged MappingMapper and original metadata helpers with schema-only adapters and published DHIS2 2.40 schemas. Supplied mappings rewrite indicator-type references; included source type objects receive destination IDs while retaining source fields. Inputs and pinned files remain unchanged. No full app, persistence or server-import behavior is established.

code_surface: At 78c8b8c22278dcbb7d2d5678eaafaa80b0fd0cf9: global mapping page omits indicator types; modelFactory registers IndicatorTypeModel; MetadataSyncUseCase invokes MappingMapper before repository save. Original mapper and metadata helpers exercised with schema-only boundaries. Existing payload-builder and mapping integration tests located but not run.
proposed_change: Verify the missing global option together with reference rewriting, mapping persistence and included-type behavior. Agree whether mapped indicator types should be reused, excluded or updated before implementing a focused change; a picker-only patch is not yet justified.
research_next_step: Complete the isolated native test-path audit (shared test/build workflow, dependencies and fixtures), then verify original model/mapping persistence and whether the builder includes mapped indicator types. Check import semantics with synthetic metadata before proposing reuse or update behavior; no operational instances.
tests: Seven isolated original-mapper checks pass with original metadata helpers, published DHIS2 2.40 schemas and explicit schema-only API/model adapters. Covers absent/supplied/disabled/unrelated mappings, global flag, included source fields, category-option control and input immutability. No native upstream suite, browser, persistence, expressions or server-import test.
environment: Node 22.16.0, TypeScript 5.8.3 transpilation, checksum-verified lodash 4.18.0 and d2-api 1.21.0 static schemas in /tmp/humanifest-malaria-integration-screen. No package install, target clone or lifecycle commands. All 33 retrieved source blobs verified against pinned Git tree. Full app baseline and exact project toolchain remain pending.
maintainer: Issue #1255 is open and unassigned with zero comments; inspected timeline has project events and no linked PR. No scope or AI/bot confirmation. No outreach sent or follow-up date invented.
risks: The mapper changes included source type IDs while retaining source fields such as factor. Destination overwrite is not demonstrated; builder inclusion and server semantics require verification. Existing PR #1051 overlaps the picker but neither #1051 nor #1251 adds this feature. AI/bot eligibility, accepted scope, full environment and benefit remain unresolved.
